metadata.question: Between June 15-21, 2017, did temperatures in Las Vegas, Nevada exceed 130 degrees fahrenheit?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need temperature data for Las Vegas, Nevada (approximately 36.17°N, -115.14°W) - Date range: June 15-21, 2017 - Options: MODIS LST (Land Surface Temperature), ERA5 (air temperature), or Landsat thermal bands - ERA5 provides air temperature in Kelvin at 2m height, which is most relevant for this question - MODIS LST provides land surface temperature which can be much higher than air temperature 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for ERA5 (reanalysis data) - For MODIS, would need QA band masking - ERA5 is more appropriate for air temperature measurement 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - 130°F = 54.44°C = 327.59 K - Normal June temperatures in Las Vegas are typically 100-115°F (37-46°C) - If result is None/NaN → C3 - If no images found → C1 - If valid temperature found, compare to 130°F threshold - Note: The record air temperature in Las Vegas is around 117°F, so 130°F would be exceptionally rare for air temperature - However, ground/surface temperatures can exceed this ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lasVegas = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.14, 36.17]); const startDate = '2017-06-15'; const endDate = '2017-06-22'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Using ERA5 hourly for air temperature let tempCol = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(lasVegas) .select('temperature_2m'); // Temperature at 2 meters in Kelvin const colSize = tempCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5 Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No ERA5 data found."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Get maximum temperature const maxTemp = tempCol.max(); // 4. Calculation - Extract max temperature value const result = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: lasVegas, scale: 27830, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const maxTempK = result.temperature_2m; // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (maxTempK === null || maxTempK === undefined || isNaN(maxTempK)) { console.log("Temperature calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Convert Kelvin to Fahrenheit: (K - 273.15) × 9/5 + 32 const maxTempF = (maxTempK - 273.15) * 9/5 + 32; const threshold = 130; console.log(`Max Temperature: ${maxTempF.toFixed(2)}°F (${maxTempK.toFixed(2)}K)`); console.log(`Threshold: ${threshold}°F`); console.log(`Date Range: ${startDate} to ${endDate}`); console.log(`Location: Las Vegas, NV`); // Sanity check: temperature should be reasonable if (maxTempF < -50 || maxTempF > 150) { console.log("Temperature out of reasonable range."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (maxTempF > threshold) { console.log(`Temperature exceeded ${threshold}°F`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Temperature did not exceed ${threshold}°F`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
